0022600096.text: The Timberwolves (1-0, on a one-game winning streak) visit the Orlando Magic (0-1, on a one-game losing streak) in Minnesota's second game of the season. Minnesota is 1-0 on the road, sits 7th in the West and 3rd in the Northwest, and is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Orlando is 4th in the Southeast and is missing Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Minnesota lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, 2026.
